$comment: Spec for src/world/gen-highrise.ts. Floors 20-31 of a 38-storey office tower (the involved floors 21-30 plus one either side). Nine zones per floor on a 2x5 grid so the split view and the 3D layout draw it: row A is the north (Penn Square) side of the floor plate, west to east; row B is the core along the south wall, west to east (TR-049 p. 3-4 and the 22nd-floor plan, printed p. 28). Rates are the step-3 calibration knobs; the values here are the starting point and carry the report's qualitative ordering: open-plan floors spread fast, rated stair and shaft enclosures leak, slabs conduct little, and windows (autoexposure) are the primary floor-to-floor path. Floor numbers are real; ids are generic.

sensors.$asBuiltNote: 1981 amendments: detectors at exit access points (A1 by the west stair, A2 by the center stair, A4 by the east stair), the corner return-air intakes (A1, A4, B2, B4) and the elevator lobbies (B2, B4). Open-plan tenant floors were only required to have detectors at the exits, so A3, the zone of origin, has none: the report says coverage was incomplete and the fire was well advanced before a detector tripped (p. 2, 6, 22). Stairs are unsensed.
